verdict.rationale: telli documents its own agent builder, where users create and test agents (draft or saved revisions), and transfer tools that move a call to another agent or number, which covers handoffs. Nothing shows the builder is a visual, multi-step flow canvas with branching or states; the workflows feature covers triggered automations rather than conversation flows. missing for 10: evidence of a visual flow canvas, explicit branching logic, conversation states, an explicit no-code guarantee, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can design multi-step conversation flows in a visual builder with branching, states, and handoffs without writing code

citations.quote: In the agent builder, click Test call to open the dialog. Pick the agent version (your draft with unsaved changes or any saved revision)
Transfer tools | Move the call to another agent or number.
Build and refine agents, automate workflows, and analyze your calls with telli's built-in AI assistant.
